categories.main_business_segments: Sansure Biotech primarily operates in the in vitro diagnostics (IVD) industry, focusing on the research, development, production, and sales of diagnostic reagents and instruments, as well as third-party medical testing services. Its product portfolio covers infectious disease prevention, maternal and child health, blood safety, cancer prevention, companion diagnostics, and includes over 1,000 products and 2,200 testing services. The company also engages in molecular diagnostics, immunodiagnostics, sequencing technologies, and provides integrated solutions including reagents, instruments, and laboratory services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced molecular biology technologies such as fluorescence quantitative PCR, nucleic acid extraction using magnetic bead methods, one-step nucleic acid release, high-throughput sequencing (NGS), targeted next-generation sequencing (tNGS), metagenomic sequencing (mNGS), whole genome sequencing (WGS), and digital PCR. It also develops immunodiagnostic platforms including electrochemiluminescence and chemiluminescence assays. Production adheres to ISO13485 and ISO9001 quality management systems, with automated and semi-automated nucleic acid extraction and amplification instruments, and integrated sample processing systems.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Sansure Biotech serves hospitals, disease control centers, third-party independent laboratories, research institutions, and public health organizations. Its products are used in clinical diagnostics, public health surveillance, research, and food safety. Key markets include infectious disease control, respiratory diseases, maternal and child health screening, blood safety testing, cancer early screening, and companion diagnostics. The company also targets both domestic and international markets, including emerging markets in Asia, Europe, Africa, and the Americas.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters and major production bases in Changsha, Shanghai, and Beijing. It has established over 30 subsidiaries and offices in major Chinese provinces and internationally in countries such as the United States, United Kingdom, France, Indonesia, the Philippines, Thailand, and others. Its products are sold in over 160 countries and regions worldwide, with localized production and operations in key overseas markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Sansure Biotech operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the IVD supply chain. It develops and manufactures diagnostic reagents and instruments and provides third-party medical testing services. The company also invests in upstream key raw materials and components through strategic investments and partnerships to enhance supply chain integration and reduce dependency on external suppliers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation in molecular diagnostics, immunodiagnostics, and sequencing technologies, focusing on simplifying, automating, and accelerating diagnostic processes. It invests heavily in R&D, with 23.4% of revenue allocated to research and development in 2023. Strategic priorities include expanding respiratory disease diagnostics, maternal and child health products, blood safety, tumor early screening, and companion diagnostics. It also pursues internationalization, platform-based ecosystem building, and digital health integration, including POCT and LDT development.
categories.revenue_model: Sansure Biotech generates revenue primarily through the sales of diagnostic reagents, instruments, and provision of medical testing services. Sales are conducted via direct sales and distribution channels. The company also earns income from strategic investments and financial asset management. Revenue recognition follows contract-based delivery and service completion, with pricing based on negotiated or tender prices.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading player in China's molecular diagnostics and IVD market, recognized among the top 100 global medical device companies and top pharmaceutical manufacturers in China. It competes with multinational corporations like Roche and Abbott, which hold dominant positions globally. Sansure Biotech differentiates itself through its comprehensive product portfolio, strong R&D capabilities, and localized international operations, aiming to break import monopolies and expand its global footprint.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, Sansure Biotech reported revenue of approximately RMB 1.007 billion, a significant decline of 84.39% compared to the previous year, primarily due to reduced demand for COVID-19 nucleic acid testing products. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 363.7 million, down 81.22% year-over-year. Despite the downturn, the company maintains a solid asset base with total assets of RMB 8.45 billion and equity of RMB 7.2 billion. The company is in a growth phase with strategic investments and product diversification driving future potential.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Sansure Biotech emphasizes high-precision, user-friendly, and accessible molecular diagnostic solutions that cover a broad spectrum of diseases and populations. Its proprietary technologies enable rapid, automated, and accurate testing, supporting precision medicine and public health needs. The company offers integrated reagent-instrument-service solutions, backed by strong R&D and quality control, aiming to provide affordable, reliable diagnostics globally. Its 'Sansure Solution' defines market ecosystems by combining innovation with comprehensive customer service and localized operations.
